title: Grayton Beach "Fair Dinkum" 157 Savelle Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps away from private beach access- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $30 per day.*- Spacious screened porch- Outdoor Shower with hot & cold water- 3 dedicated parking spots - 1 covered and 2 uncovered- 5 adult bikes- Gas grill- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Want to find out what makes the #1 Beach in America so unique? Book a stay at "Fair Dinkum" to see for yourself why Grayton Beach is so well-loved among locals and visitors! This 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom house truly has all you need for the perfect beach vacation, including a private pool, screened porch, complimentary bikes, private parking, an outdoor shower, and to top it all off, it's located only steps from sugar-white sand! 157 Savelle Drive is surrounded by state park-protected land, meaning it provides the highest level of privacy and seclusion. This home was recently remodeled in 2021 to reflect a stunning coastal feel with brand new appliances, countertops, and furniture. The first floor of the home begins with an entry that leads to a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-full bunk beds. The bunk room shares a full bathroom with the hallway, which has a shower/tub combination. The second level of the home encompasses the living and kitchen area, which opens up directly to the screened-in porch. The kitchen features sparkling white quartz countertops and stainless-steel appliances. There is room for 10 people to eat comfortably at both the kitchen's bar and dining table. The living room also features 2 cozy sofas and chairs around the flat-screen TV. The remaining bedrooms can also be found on this floor, beginning with the primary suite, which has a king bed and private bathroom. The next room has a queen bed and private bathroom, while the neighboring room has a king bed and private bathroom. The final guest room features 2 full-size beds with a private bathroom. After a day of fun in the sun, guests will love lounging on the home's spacious screened-in porch, relishing in the beautiful Florida evenings. When you aren't hanging out at the pool or the beach, be sure to explore the surrounding 30A area, which provides wonderful shopping and dining venues that are just a short drive away. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Bunk Room: Two Sets of Twin-over-Full Bunks, Hallway Access to Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private With Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlyParties, weddings, or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing. Fees apply. *Unfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.
